out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed several big plastic containers that have been cleaned not stored inverted on a storage rack in dishwashing area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted CFM to store the clean containers inverted.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: - OBSERVED: quaternary ammonia concentration less than 150ppm. The chemical mixing dispenser is in need of calibration.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM will place a work order. Before the chemical mixing dispenser is serviced, the CFM will need to manually adjust the concentration of quaternary ammonia to 200-400 ppm.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. - OBSERVED: a chemical mixing dispenser connected down stream from a mop sink which is equipped with an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated the CFM. CFM will re-install the approved splitter on the mop sink.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the prep sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. PLEASE FORWARD THE SIGNED COPIES TO EHS WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED AN EXTRA COPY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: (1) OBSERVED THE HAND SINK AT SERVICE LINE WAS USED TO STORE AN SOILED CUP. (2) A FOOD EMPLOYEE RINSED THE FILTER OF ESPRESSO MACHINE AT SERVICE LINE HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS EDUCATED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at THE handwashing sink NEAR OVEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at THE handwashing sink NEAR OVEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the @LOCATION@ is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. THERE IS NO WATER AT THE HAND SINK NEAR OVEN.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: SLICED TOMATO (57F), FRESH MOZZARELLA CHEESE (51F), SOUR CREAM (53F), HARD BOILED EGGS (57F), CUT HAM (47F), COOKED MUSHROOM (44F), SAUSAGE PATTIES (48F), SLICED TURKEY (54F), AND PORTIONED TUNA (53F) WERE STORED IN 3-DOOR PREP COOLER (#2) OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). EHS PROMPTED THE CFM TO DISCARD THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED SEVERAL PACKAGES OF FOOD ITEMS STORED ON FLOOR OF WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 3- DOOR PREP COOLER (#2) AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE UNIT.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH and a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER DIRECTLY CONNECTED DOWN STREAM FROM THE MOP SINK WITH AN ATMOSPHERIC BREAKER.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILLL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES IN DISHWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PEST CONTROL SERVICE WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.observation: The door gaskets of WALK-IN COOLER are damaged.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications.

violations.observation: HAND SINK LOCATED AT THE DISHROOM IS DEFECTIVE.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE HAND SINK AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.
